card.name: Course description wording in syllabi
card.fires_on: Words in university course descriptions and syllabi, most strongly "goals" after "Student learning". Also fires on small words in course blurbs, such as "required", "to" in "Open to", and "students" after "will provide".

modes.label: Student learning goals
modes.description: The word "goals" right after the heading "Student learning" in a course syllabus.
